scope: Public primary evidence and frozen project authority; no new engineering approval

sources.SOURCE_TITLE: 食品安全国家标准 食品生产通用卫生规范
sources.PUBLISHER: 国家卫生健康委、市场监管总局；济阳区市场监管局公开标准原文
sources.ENGINEERING_REQUIREMENT: Space must support production, cleaning, maintenance and personnel operations. Changing capacity follows each shift; segregate work and personal clothes and provide process-dependent hygiene facilities. Equipment installation must support cleaning/maintenance.
sources.LIMITATIONS: These clauses do not give a universal locker aisle, minimum room short side or aspect ratio. Food-process applicability and hygiene zoning require project confirmation. No quotation of the old 2013 clauses as current.

requirements.requirement: Provide capacity-appropriate space for equipment, operations, cleaning and maintenance.
Changing room at production entrance; space/facility quantity appropriate to shift staffing and separated clothing storage.
Determine footwear and hand-hygiene facilities from cleanliness/process requirements; do not omit their footprints.
Equipment mounting or separation must permit cleaning and maintenance.

sources.SOURCE_TITLE: GB50072-2021 冷库设计标准（国标电子书库目录与试读）
sources.PUBLISHER: 中国建筑标准设计研究院国标电子书库；标准批准部门住建部
RELEVANT_CLAUSE_OR_SECTION: catalogue: 1 总则; 4 建筑; 6 制冷
sources.ENGINEERING_REQUIREMENT: Use the cold-store design standard where the project falls within its scope; it is not evidence of a universal office/changing/coating minimum width.
sources.LIMITATIONS: Metadata and chapter scope verified, not every technical clause. Government-hosted full PDF returned HTTP405 in web fetch. No numeric room-width clause is asserted from this source. Check interaction with current mandatory general codes in professional design review.

sources.SOURCE_TITLE: 办公建筑设计标准：现行目录与试读
sources.PUBLISHER: 中国建筑标准设计研究院国标电子书库；住建部行业标准
sources.ENGINEERING_REQUIREMENT: Office use and layout need an applicable office-design review. This recommended industry standard's catalogue is not a verified numerical clause.
sources.LIMITATIONS: Public trial did not expose clause text for a reliable normative numeric extraction. No per-person area, room width or staffing capacity is adopted. Applicability to a processing-factory ancillary office must be confirmed; /T does not make all wording a project mandate.

sources.SOURCE_TITLE: 住建部发布《民用建筑通用规范》公告
sources.CURRENT_VALIDITY: PUBLICATION_VERIFIED; effective 2023-03-01; current project scope/code hierarchy requires professional review
RELEVANT_CLAUSE_OR_SECTION: 发布公告：强制性通用规范及冲突优先规则
sources.ENGINEERING_REQUIREMENT: Where applicable, the mandatory general code takes precedence over conflicting existing engineering standards.
sources.LIMITATIONS: No universal numeric passage/door width extracted from announcement. It is not automatically applicable to every industrial production room; applicability must be determined, not inferred from its title.

requirements.requirement: Professional design must determine applicable general-code precedence; not a room-size threshold.

sources.SOURCE_TITLE: MITTZON 米特丛书桌 s19529082 产品尺寸
sources.ENGINEERING_REQUIREMENT: Example desk footprint 1600x800mm; chair, pullback, passage and furniture storage are additional input envelopes.
sources.LIMITATIONS: Product specification only, not a recommended procurement or confirmed project desk. Use assembled product dimensions, not package dimensions. Does not establish an aisle or ergonomic clearance.

sources.STANDARD_VERSION: catalogue title 2024; ML03S1; PDF page11 / printed20-21
sources.ENGINEERING_REQUIREMENT: Example one-compartment cabinet: height1700, width322, depth500mm. A double opposing row occupies at least1000mm before any aisle/door/user space.
sources.LIMITATIONS: The illustration labels600mm for another pictured cabinet; the selected ML03S1 table row is322mm wide. No door sweep, clean/dirty separation approval, bench or aisle size supplied. Not confirmed for this food plant.

RELEVANT_CLAUSE_OR_SECTION: Technical Features / Product Specifications; FAQ does machine apply wax
sources.ENGINEERING_REQUIREMENT: Published dimensions990W x633L x2018H mm are for a pineapple wax dilution/dosing unit, not the wax application line.
sources.LIMITATIONS: Explicitly does not apply wax to fruit. Cannot establish blueberry applicability, a complete coating-room footprint or installation clearances. Published rounded mm values retained without reconstructing from rounded inches.

sources.ENGINEERING_REQUIREMENT: Brush-based wax application can integrate with washers, dryers and graders. Published width categories1000/1500/2000mm accompany output ratings.
sources.LIMITATIONS: These width categories are not a verified overall installation envelope. Overall length, service/removal spaces and project applicability remain unavailable; do not compare category2000 directly with room1950 as formal failure.

sources.SOURCE_TITLE: ROBOPAC ECOPLAT PLUS USE AND MAINTENANCE MANUAL
sources.CURRENT_VALIDITY: VERIFIED_LEGACY_MANUAL_SPECIFIC_TO_MODEL_EDITION; not project-bound or a current universal rule
sources.ENGINEERING_REQUIREMENT: Stretch-film pallet wrapper has distinct operator, loading and perimeter areas. Base standard drawing gives D2490 and E1640mm machine plan extents. Perimeter diagram labels800 and1500mm minimums at specific illustrated sides/areas.
sources.LIMITATIONS: Not a fruit-coating applicator. Never apply800/1500 to every side or treat them as general pedestrian aisle rules; diagram anchors and model must be bound. A bare1640mm dimension fitting1950mm does not prove the normal/maintenance/material-flow envelopes fit.

sources.ENGINEERING_REQUIREMENT: Consider clothing storage/changing and adequate workstation/seating space as functional requirements, not just floor area.
sources.LIMITATIONS: Foreign qualitative reference only; no Chinese minimum room width or automatic legal applicability is inferred.
